key_insight: CatAI reuses physicochemical knowledge through modular encoders to guide catalyst discovery across mechanistically distinct reactions.
engineering_relevance: Reusable models could help engineers screen catalysts and steer experimental optimization toward reaction-specific performance goals.
method: Learn 1.8 million structure–property relations using 30 physicochemical encoders.
Compose encoders into task-specific catalyst prediction models.
Guide computational screening and closed-loop model–experiment optimization.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports 7.8% lower task-averaged prediction error than next-best models, a polymer-synthesis catalyst with 9× commercial-benchmark activity, and a Cu-based photocatalyst outperforming traditional Ni-based systems for C–O coupling.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish long-term catalyst stability, scale-up performance, or transferability beyond the evaluated systems.
paper_title: Adaptive catalyst discovery emerges from composable scientific intelligence
